Site.name: Kian Behsaz
Site.description: Kian Behsaz manufactures engineered building materials for industrial, commercial and residential projects.

Home.heroTitle: Build infrastructure with materials that hold up
Home.heroSubtitle: Kian Behsaz manufactures engineered building materials for industrial, commercial and infrastructure projects.
Home.introBody: Quality is controlled at every step, from the production line to the job site. The result is material that delivers the specification it is sold on.
Home.productsBody: Our products are grouped by application so the technical choice is straightforward.
Home.projectsBody: A selection of projects built with Kian Behsaz materials.
Home.productionBody: An automated line with continuous monitoring of process parameters.
Home.technologyBody: Investment in equipment and laboratory capacity is what makes quality repeatable.
Home.qualityBody: Every batch is tested before release, and the test report is available on request.
Home.sustainabilityBody: Lower energy use and recycling of production waste are part of the plant's operating plan.
Home.ctaBody: Send us the technical requirements and our engineering team will propose a suitable option.

About.title: About Kian Behsaz
About.subtitle: A building materials manufacturer focused on repeatable quality.
About.historyBody: Kian Behsaz started with a single production line and today covers several product families.

About.valueQualityBody: Every technical claim is backed by a test report.
About.valuePartnershipBody: Our engineers stay with the client from design through execution.

Quality.title: Quality
Quality.subtitle: Quality control, testing and certification.
Quality.labBody: Mechanical and physical tests are run on a sample from every production batch.
Quality.step1Body: Every raw material shipment is tested before it enters the line.
Quality.step2Body: Process parameters are recorded and monitored continuously.
Quality.step3Body: Each batch is sampled and tested against the reference standards.
Quality.step4Body: A shipment is released only once its test report is approved.

Sustainability.wasteBody: Returning production waste to the raw material cycle.
Sustainability.waterBody: A closed industrial water loop across parts of the process.
Sustainability.communityBody: Local employment and sourcing around the plant.
